detail_of_failure: All work equipment, swing and travel do not work.
related_information: Pre-troubleshooting If a failure code is shown, do the troubleshooting for that code first. Reference information Do all the troubleshooting while the working mode is set to Power mode (P).

steps.procedure: 1. Stop the engine. 2. Release the pressure that remains in the hydraulic tank and piping. For details, see Testing and Adjusting, “Release Remained Pressure in Hydraulic Circuit”. 3. Remove the main oil pressure measurement plug. 4. Turn the starting switch to the ON position. 5. Examine it. For details, see Testing and Adjusting, “Procedure to Perform No-Injection Cranking”. 6. Does oil flow out of the main oil pressure measurement plug?

branches.YES: • The piston pump is correct. • Go to the next check item.
branches.NO: • The piston pump is defective. • Repair or replace the piston pump. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.procedure: 1. The pump shaft is possibly not in rotation because of an internal defect in the damper. Do an examination. 2. Does the pump shaft rotate?

branches.YES: • The damper is correct. • Go to the next check item.
branches.NO: • The damper is defective. • Repair or replace the damper. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.procedure: 1. Stop the engine. 2. Connect all the component parts. 3. Start the engine. 4. Operate the lever to do the troubleshooting. 5. Do the work equipment, swing and travel operate normally?

branches.NO: Go back to the first check item.
